Name: The Aquarium Gravel
Author: DimmyLimmy
Description:
Hello there,
I felt like something was quite lacking with the aquariums in the game. The have no pop, no pazazz, no coolness. So I made the coolest mod ever, the all mighty Aquarium Gravel mod. Inspired by real-life fish tanks that I always see when ever I go to PetSmart, it is the weird "glow" gravel.

This is for every fish tank
Now includes the community center :)

[i](3/18/2025)
[s]Update: I am working on getting it into the community center fish tank :D
[/s]
(3/31/2025)
Update: It has been done...[/i]

Downloads.Description: The long awaited Community Center Aquarium Gravel change.

Manifest.Name: The Aquarium Gravel
Manifest.Description: Puts that ugly colorful aquarium gravel in your aquarium, I love it.
